start: litfass: house adverts for websites, Mini Apps, bots and channels. /register – show adverts in your site, bot or channel /mine – your placements and their feed URLs /stats – how your placements are doing /cancel – stop the current input
start_admin: Admin /ads – manage adverts /newad – create an advert /publishers – all placements /stats – how the adverts are doing
ask_new_url: Send the link the advert leads to (https://…).
ask_pub_name: What is the name of your website, bot or channel?
feed_url: Feed URL (keep it to yourself, it identifies your placement):
feed_howto: Web: fetchFeed(url) from @militaernews/litfass, bots: the litfass Python package. Adverts must stay labelled as adverts (e.g. „Anzeige“).
p_texts: Send the language code on the first line (en, de, ru, …), then title, text and button label on one line each. Example: de Unser Kanal Täglich aktuell. Kanal öffnen To remove a language send only de -.
p_emoji: Send one emoji, or - to remove it.
p_colors: Send three colours: background, text and accent, e.g. #14161a #f5f5f5 #e5484d
p_sched: Send start and end as 2026-12-01 2027-01-07; use - for an open side (- 2027-01-07), or just - to run always. The end day is not included.
p_image: Send a photo, or - to remove the image.
e_name: Please send a name between 2 and 60 characters.
e_https_retry: That is not an https:// link. Try again or /cancel.
e_four_lines: I need four lines: language, title, text, button label.
e_too_long: The {field} is too long (at most {max} characters).
e_https: That is not an https:// link.
e_two_dates: Send two dates (or - for an open side).
e_end: The end has to be after the start.
e_photo: Send a photo (or - to remove the image).
pick_content: {name} What kind of content do you publish? Pick all that fit; adverts are chosen to match. Pick none to take every advert.
what_content: What kind of content do you publish?
new_key: New key: the old feed URL stops working.
delete_pub: Delete {name}? Its feed URL stops working.
ad_content: Which content does this advert fit? None means every placement.
ad_places: Where may this advert appear? None means everywhere.
ad_style: Pick a colour preset and a layout, or set your own colours.
ad_weight: How often should this advert come up compared to the others?
command.register: Show adverts in your site, bot or channel
menu_title: What would you like to do?
post_empty: No live advert to post yet — an admin has to publish one first.
post_fail: I cannot post here. Add me as an admin with “send messages” permission.
